description: `(req: HttpRequest<unknown>, next: HttpHandlerFn) => Observable<HttpEvent<unknown>>`. Runs in an injection context.
Registers functional interceptors in `provideHttpClient()`. Requests pass through them in array order; responses come back in reverse order.
Requests are immutable. `clone({ setHeaders, setParams, url, body, context })` creates a modified copy.
Typed per-request metadata (`new HttpContextToken(() => default)`) that interceptors read with `req.context.get(TOKEN)`.
`next()` emits several events (Sent, progress, `HttpResponse`). Filter with `instanceof HttpResponse` when you need the final response.
`@Injectable` classes implementing `HttpInterceptor`, registered via the `HTTP_INTERCEPTORS` multi-provider and `withInterceptorsFromDi()`.
